description.p: ZPLinux is a WYSIWYG label designer for Zebra and other thermal printers that understand ZPL. Lay out a label and print it over the network, to a USB printer, through a raw CUPS queue, or save the ZPL to a file.

ul.li: Text, boxes, lines, ellipses and images, and 29 barcode types: Code 128, QR, Code 39, EAN/UPC, GS1-128, GS1 DataBar, Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec, MaxiCode and more
Templates for shipping, product, price, address and asset labels
Variables filled in by hand or from a CSV file for batch printing
Several labels open at once in tabs
Saved printers with a default, and a connection test
Live ZPL view, ZPL and PNG export
Import ZPL, such as ZebraDesigner's print-to-file output

description.p: Label orientation now rotates what prints: design a landscape label and print it turned onto stock that feeds the other way.

ul.li: Rotate text, barcodes and images in 90 degree steps
Turn the whole design on screen for labels read sideways (changed in 0.6.1)

description.p: Labelix is now ZPLinux. Labels save as .zplinux; .labelix files still open, and settings carry over from Labelix.
On the Label tab, Enter in a variable moves on to the next one.
Objects can be moved partly or wholly off the label while designing; only the part on the label prints.

ul.li: 27 more barcode types, including Code 39, EAN/UPC, GS1-128, GS1 DataBar, Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec and MaxiCode
ZPL import reads these barcodes as their own types

description.p: Barcodes can set the size of the text printed under them.

ul.li: Import ZPL files, such as ZebraDesigner's print-to-file .prn, as editable labels
Code 128 barcodes pack runs of digits in pairs, as ZebraDesigner does
Edit several labels at once in tabs
Save several named printers and choose a default

description.p: Blue header bar in the style of ZebraDesigner.
